visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short reddish-brown hair, wearing a beige baseball cap and a black t-shirt, stands in the busy outdoor shopping district of Ximending during the day. She holds the camera in a selfie-style handheld shot, speaking with an animated facial expression and clear hand gestures. The background features structural columns and blurred pedestrians in natural daylight. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of a plastic cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea from 'Xing Fu Tang'. The woman holds the cup, which is filled with white milk and dark syrup swirls, and drinks through a black straw. (3) The scene transitions to the woman eating 'Ay-Chung Flour-Rice Noodle' from a white paper bowl. She uses a clear plastic spoon to scoop the noodles and cilantro, showing a close-up of the food before eating it in a crowded street setting. (4) The woman is then seen eating mango shaved ice at 'Three Brothers'. A large bowl of white ice topped with mango chunks and a scoop of ice cream is shown. She smiles and laughs as she eats, with pink floral stickers and variety-style text appearing around her face in a bright indoor restaurant lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins speaking with high energy and a fast tempo, welcoming viewers to Ximending. Bright, upbeat electronic BGM with synth pads and a driving 4/4 beat plays underneath. Faint urban chatter and outdoor ambience are audible. (2) A sharp 'Ding' bell SFX triggers as the scene changes. The speaker continues her narration with rising intonation. A wet, percussive slurping sound occurs as she drinks. (3) A 'Whoosh' transition SFX marks the start of a new phase. The speaker's tone becomes more descriptive. Background ambient noise increases with street sounds. Sound of plastic rustling and a spoon clinking against a paper bowl is heard. (4) A bubbly 'Pop' SFX sounds. The female speaker laughs with high vocal arousal. A second female voice briefly comments in the background. High-pitched sparkle-like SFX are layered over the music as the speaker expresses joy while eating dessert. (5) The BGM swells slightly as the speaker finishes her sentence, ending with a final percussive thud that signals the end of the video segment.
